summary: Published work establishes living, repository-local knowledge practices; Agent Studio supplies the current operational evidence for the explicit two-way loop.

items.text: Cyrille Martraire, Living Documentation — documentation should evolve with the code through continuous investment and automation.
Write the Docs, Docs as Code — shared version-control and review workflows make documentation changes traceable and automatable.
Michael Nygard, Documenting Architecture Decisions — changing context and superseded decisions remain visible rather than being overwritten.
Agent Studio field evidence — Wiki Pulse, commits-behind drift grading, Quality Review and the 24 July target-state consolidation.
